en.title: How to Buy Goods on the Marketplace
en.excerpt: A complete guide to finding, purchasing, and receiving archery equipment from the archeris.net Marketplace.
en.content:
Find Products

You can find the product you want in several ways:

  • Search — Type a product name, brand, or keyword in the Marketplace search field.
  • Category Filters — Use the filters in the sidebar to narrow results by category, price, or item condition.
  • Recommendations — The Marketplace homepage displays popular products and editors' picks relevant to your interests.

Reading Product Details

Before purchasing, check the product details carefully:

  • Product photos — View from different angles. Photos that are blurry or very sparse are worth being wary of.
  • Description — Make sure the specifications, size and material meet your needs.
  • Store info — See store ratings and reviews from previous buyers.
  • Stock status — Make sure the product is still available before adding to your cart.
💡
Ask Seller
Doubtful about product specifications? Use the live chat feature on the product page to ask the seller before making a purchase.

Checkout & Payment Process

  1. Click Add to Cart or directly Buy Now.
  2. On the cart page, double check the list of items, quantities, and prices.
  3. Select delivery method (regular courier, express, or pick-up).
  4. Enter a complete and correct shipping address.
  5. Select payment method: bank transfer, virtual account, credit/debit card, or digital wallet.
  6. Click Pay Now and complete the payment before the deadline.
🔒
Secure Funds with Escrow System
Your payment funds are not passed directly to the seller. Funds are held by the archeris.net system (escrow) and will only be disbursed to the seller after you confirm that the goods have been received properly.

Track Order

After successful payment, track the order status in Dashboard > My Orders. Status that may appear:

Status Meaning
Waiting for ConfirmationThe seller is processing your order.
ProcessedSeller prepares shipping package.
DeliveredPackage on its way. Receipt number available.
CompletedGoods received and transaction completed.
CanceledOrder cancelled. Refund processed.

Confirm receipt of goods

After the goods arrive, check the condition of the package and the contents of the shipment. If appropriate, click Confirm Received in the order details. This step is important because:

  • Payment funds will only be disbursed to the seller after you confirm.
  • The transaction goes into the purchase history and can be assessed/reviewed.

If it is not confirmed within 7 days after the "Delivered" status, the system automatically considers the item received.

Returns & Complaints

If the item does not match the description, is damaged, or was sent incorrectly, submit a complaint before confirming receipt via the Ask a Problem button on the order details page. The archeris.net team will mediate and the final decision follows the applicable buyer protection policy.

id.title: Cara Membeli Barang di Marketplace
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap untuk menemukan, membeli, dan menerima perlengkapan panahan dari Marketplace archeris.net.
id.content:
Menemukan Produk

Anda dapat menemukan produk yang diinginkan melalui beberapa cara:

  • Pencarian — Ketik nama produk, merek, atau kata kunci di kolom pencarian Marketplace.
  • Filter Kategori — Gunakan filter di sidebar untuk mempersempit hasil berdasarkan kategori, harga, atau kondisi barang.
  • Rekomendasi — Halaman utama Marketplace menampilkan produk populer dan pilihan editor yang relevan dengan minat Anda.

Membaca Detail Produk

Sebelum membeli, periksa detail produk dengan cermat:

  • Foto produk — Lihat dari berbagai sudut. Foto yang buram atau sangat sedikit patut diwaspadai.
  • Deskripsi — Pastikan spesifikasi, ukuran, dan material sesuai kebutuhan Anda.
  • Info toko — Lihat rating toko dan ulasan dari pembeli sebelumnya.
  • Status stok — Pastikan produk masih tersedia sebelum dimasukkan ke keranjang.
💡
Tanya Penjual
Ragu dengan spesifikasi produk? Gunakan fitur chat langsung di halaman produk untuk bertanya kepada penjual sebelum melakukan pembelian.

Proses Checkout & Pembayaran

  1. Klik Tambah ke Keranjang atau langsung Beli Sekarang.
  2. Di halaman keranjang, periksa kembali daftar item, jumlah, dan harga.
  3. Pilih metode pengiriman (kurir reguler, express, atau pick-up).
  4. Masukkan alamat pengiriman yang lengkap dan benar.
  5. Pilih metode pembayaran: transfer bank, virtual account, kartu kredit/debit, atau dompet digital.
  6. Klik Bayar Sekarang dan selesaikan pembayaran sebelum batas waktu.
🔒
Dana Aman dengan Sistem Escrow
Dana pembayaran Anda tidak langsung diteruskan ke penjual. Dana ditahan sistem archeris.net (escrow) dan baru dicairkan ke penjual setelah Anda mengonfirmasi barang diterima dengan baik.

Melacak Pesanan

Setelah pembayaran berhasil, lacak status pesanan di Dashboard > Pesanan Saya. Status yang mungkin muncul:

Status Artinya
Menunggu KonfirmasiPenjual sedang memroses pesanan Anda.
DiprosesPenjual menyiapkan paket kiriman.
DikirimPaket dalam perjalanan. Nomor resi tersedia.
SelesaiBarang diterima dan transaksi selesai.
DibatalkanPesanan dibatalkan. Refund diproses.

Konfirmasi Penerimaan Barang

Setelah barang tiba, periksa kondisi paket dan isi kiriman. Jika sesuai, klik Konfirmasi Diterima di detail pesanan. Langkah ini penting karena:

  • Dana pembayaran baru dicairkan ke penjual setelah Anda mengonfirmasi.
  • Transaksi masuk ke riwayat pembelian dan dapat dinilai/diulas.

Jika tidak dikonfirmasi dalam 7 hari setelah status "Dikirim", sistem secara otomatis menganggap barang diterima.

Retur & Komplain

Jika barang tidak sesuai deskripsi, rusak, atau salah kirim, ajukan komplain sebelum mengonfirmasi penerimaan melalui tombol Ajukan Masalah di halaman detail pesanan. Tim archeris.net akan memediasi dan keputusan akhir mengikuti kebijakan perlindungan pembeli yang berlaku.
